mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This effect is persistent and does not require additional triggering conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to quality in equities, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The interaction effect is stronger than the sum of individual effects.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals an early-stage economic slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. This effect is strongest in the initial phase of production contraction.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 35% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the effect size is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of nonfarm employment (PAYEMS > 143 million) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds consistently across business cycles.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for PAYEMS is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS is above the 5-year median.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL year-over-year > 2.5%) signals potential monetary tightening that prompts equity sell-offs, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicate a severe labor market contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The interaction effect dominates individual series effects.
failure_condition: The interaction term is not significant (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST < 1200 thousand units) during early housing downturns signals reduced consumer spending momentum, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. This effect is most pronounced in the initial phase of housing weakness.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 35% of instances when HOUST < 1200, or the effect size is not significant (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.
